visualPlan.coreConcept: Reservoir Sampling: Selecting a fair random sample from an infinite or unknown stream of data using constant memory.
visualPlan.visualMetaphor: A linear stream of data packets flowing into a single memory slot (the reservoir), where a probability counter determines if the incoming packet replaces the current occupant.

scenes.visualAction: A rapid stream of blocks (Comment IDs) enters from the left and exits right. A red 'X' appears over a 'RAM' icon to show we can't store them.
The stream stretches into a foggy 'infinity' zone on the right. A question mark appears over the 'Total Count' variable.
A single blue box (The Reservoir) descends into the center. Block #1 enters it. Block #1,000,000 is seen far back in the queue.

scenes.visualFocus: The Reservoir box containing a block.
scenes.visualAction: Block #1 is inside the box. A 'Current Winner' label glows above it.

scenes.visualFocus: The collision point of the new block and the reservoir.
scenes.visualAction: Block #2 arrives. Above it, text 'P = 1/2' appears. A die rolls; it fails. Block #2 bounces off. Block #3 arrives, 'P = 1/3'. Die rolls; it succeeds. Block #3 kicks Block #1 out and takes the spot.

scenes.visualFocus: The long-term state of the stream.
scenes.visualAction: The stream speeds up. We see the '1/n' fraction denominator increasing (1/100, 1/1000). The block in the reservoir changes less and less frequently, but fairly.
The single Reservoir box morphs/stretches into five side-by-side slots. The formula '1/n' turns into a 'k/n' placeholder with a question mark.
The 5-slot reservoir continues to process blocks in the background while social media icons and 'Prasanna / Zoho' text overlay the top. The stream continues to flow into the 5 slots.

visuals.description: A linear stream of data packets flowing into a single memory slot (the reservoir), where a probability counter determines if the incoming packet replaces the current occupant. - 8 scenes
